## What Is Copy Trading
### How It Works
Copy trading lets you automatically replicate the trades of experienced investors. When a leader opens a position, your account mirrors it proportionally based on the amount you’ve allocated. No manual order entry is required, making the process hands‑free for beginners and busy professionals alike.

### Why It Matters in 2026
The rise of AI‑driven analytics and tighter regulation has made copy trading both safer and more transparent. Platforms now offer real‑time performance dashboards, risk scores, and social‑fi incentives that reward both leaders and followers. As more retail traders seek passive income streams, choosing the right service becomes a critical decision.
